title: LoadShape v1 — one measured mesh size: the join (a fresh gossip mesh of this many fixture citizens run to convergence) and the steady window (every node beating fresh on the liveness interval, each beat-round gossiped to convergence) counted apart — rounds, virtual seconds, exchanges and messages in each phase and in total, the mesh's own beat bookkeeping (stored, duplicate, stale) and refused exchanges at the end, whether every phase converged inside the round budget, the measured canonical-JSON sizes of one heartbeat, one registry entry, and one node's whole state offer, and the two computed rates (messages per node, messages per node per virtual second over the measured elapsed time); every count was counted by the Y-055/Y-054 components themselves — simulated is a constant, no socket was opened and no LAN crossed (Y-072)
